ns2:section.sectionText: Sapora Symposium: Profiles in RST Leadership Semester long speaker series of high profile industry leaders will explore how managers, coaches, and executives are growing their organizations and responding to a changing society. Conversations will speak specifically to the challenges every manager encounters, provide practice for developing leadership skills, and offer personal experiences for self-reflection. This synchronous online course will have (live) Zoom conversations that will be scheduled on Thursday evenings at 6:00 p.m.-6:50 p.m. This course uses Illinois Compass for all course instruction and interaction. You will receive an email from the instructor with specific directives.
